article: For each question, write the correct answer. Starting at college Hi, my name's Emma. Welcome to the college! I've been studying here for a year now. Starting at college isn't easy, but I'm sure you'll soon feel at home. When I first started studying here last year, I was (27)…………… nervous that I couldn't even ask anyone for help. I got lost five times on my first day!  Remember that (28)…………… student at the college has been new at one time, and understands how you feel. So (29)…………… you're not sure where to go, just ask - we're all happy to help!  You probably don't know many people here. To make some friends, (30)…………… not spend break times with some of your new classmates in the cafe? Or how (31)…………… joining one of the many clubs we have at the college? (32)…………… are lots to choose from.  Good luck on your new course!

explanations.27:
原因：“so...that...” 结果状语从句，“太紧张以至于无法求助”。
语法点：so + adj. + that...，如 so tired that I fell asleep.
explanations.28:
原因：“every/each student” 强调 “每个学生” 都曾是新生。
词汇点：every/each 后接单数名词，each 可强调个体，every 强调整体。
explanations.29:
原因：条件 / 时间状语从句引导词，“如果 / 当你不确定时”。
语法点：if 表条件，when 表时间，如 If you need help, call me.
explanations.30:
原因：“why not + 动词原形” 表建议，“为什么不……”。
语法点：why not do sth.，如 Why not go for a walk?
explanations.31:
原因：“how about + 动名词” 表建议，“…… 怎么样”。
语法点：how about doing sth.，如 How about having a picnic?
explanations.32:
原因：there be 句型，“有很多俱乐部可选”。
语法点：there are + 复数名词，如 There are many books on the shelf.
